description: This file implements the sched_config_manager class and related event classes for managing scheduler configurations, including adding, updating, and removing cells and UEs, as well as handling configuration completion events and metrics updates.

classes.name: ue_config_update_event
classes.description: Represents an event for updating UE configuration, handling success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: ue_config_delete_event
classes.description: Represents an event for deleting UE configuration, with reset functionality.

classes.name: sched_config_manager
classes.description: Manages scheduler configuration including cells and UEs, handles configuration events, and interacts with metrics and notifier components.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell configuration based on the provided request message.

methods.name: update_cell
methods.description: Updates an existing cell configuration with new RRM policies.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell configuration and associated metrics.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates a new UE configuration based on the creation request message.

methods.name: update_ue
methods.description: Updates an existing UE configuration with new parameters.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Initiates removal of a UE configuration.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of UE configuration, updating metrics and notifying completion status.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of UE deletion, cleaning up metrics and internal state.

methods.name: flush_ues_to_rem
methods.description: Clears the queue of UEs pending removal.
